title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults
population: Healthy adults performing resistance training with or without protein supplementation

keyFinding.enGB: Meta-regression supports diminishing returns for hypertrophy beyond roughly 1.6 g protein per kg body mass per day in healthy adults who lift.
